title: Prospective physical-Retina Walle two-wallpaper reveal composition gate

capture.device: Apple M1 Max with built-in Liquid Retina XDR display

candidate.composition: select the incoming RGBA8 texel inside and outgoing RGBA8 texel outside with no interpolation or edge blend

procedure: Commit and publish this preregistration, diagnostic capture mode, validator, tests, and native runner before the first answer-bearing capture.
Build GlassCapture with Apple Command Line Tools only in the clean committed checkout.
Run directly in the active, awake, unlocked, on-console 2x Retina session without GitHub Actions, a debugger, or a Nix-store path in the native build or capture environment.
Capture the cold forward, warm reverse, and cold-repeat 17-state exact sweeps using the pure wallpaper-reveal mode.
Only after native capture exits, use the repository Nix environment for validation.

claimBoundary.successfulGatePromotes: the exact two-wallpaper reveal-mask and source-selection composition used beneath Walle's Apple-native circle transition over this physical-Retina size, position, and 17-state radius sweep
successfulGateDoesNotPromote: physical Retina presentation of Walle-produced pixels
circle-mask arithmetic outside the admitted physical-pixel domain
